_comment: argv[0] values the shell tool may run without asking a human first.
The threat this guards against is the agent doing something surprising --
a prompt injection in a fetched page, a misread instruction -- not a
malicious operator, who could simply approve whatever they wanted.
So the bar for auto-approval is: the command cannot execute arbitrary
code and cannot open a network connection. That rules out python, node,
git, curl, wget, and also find (-exec) and awk (system()). They are not
blocked, they just stop and ask -- which is the feature working, not a
failure. 'denied' is the narrower list that never runs at all.
